sentence: Deep into that darkness peering, long I stood there wondering, fearing, / Doubting, dreaming dreams no mortal ever dared to dream before;

source.author: Edgar Allan Poe
source.detail: 第五节开头两行；今天是万圣节，选一句爱伦·坡最有名的“暗夜”诗句应景

translation: 我久久伫立，凝望那深深的黑暗，惊疑、恐惧，满腹狐疑，做着从没有凡人敢做的梦。
grammar: 主干只有一句：I stood there（我站在那里）。long 是状语（久久地），被提到主语前面，形成 long I stood 的倒装语序，这是诗歌里为了节奏和强调常用的手法，正常散文语序是 I stood there long。

大量现在分词短语作伴随状语：peering, wondering, fearing, doubting, dreaming 都在描述“站着的同时”在做什么、感受什么。Deep into that darkness peering 也是倒装的分词短语，正常语序是 peering deep into that darkness，把 deep into that darkness 提前，画面感一下子就出来了。

dreams no mortal ever dared to dream before 是省略了关系代词的定语从句：dreams (that) no mortal ever dared to dream before。关系代词在从句中作宾语时可以省略，这在口语和写作里都很常见。另外 dreaming dreams 是“同源宾语”（动词和宾语同根），类似 live a happy life、smile a bitter smile，读起来更有力。

vocab.collocation: peer into / peer at / peer through
vocab.example: She peered into the dark room, looking for the light switch.

vocab.collocation: wonder about / wonder if / wonder why
vocab.example: I wonder why the bootloader keeps resetting.

vocab.collocation: no doubt / beyond doubt / doubt whether
vocab.example: I doubt whether this fix will work on the old board.

vocab.collocation: mere mortals / mortal danger / mortal enemy
vocab.example: This kind of optimization is beyond us mere mortals.

vocab.collocation: dare to do / how dare you / I dare say
vocab.example: Few engineers dared to touch the legacy code.

note: 小练习：试着把这两行改回正常语序读一遍，I stood there long, peering deep into that darkness, wondering, fearing, doubting... 再对比原句，感受一下倒装带来的节奏。也可以学着用 mere mortals 自嘲一句，比如 This is too hard for us mere mortals. 万圣节快乐 🎃
